product_metadata.title: Springform Cake Pan Set Of 3 (4 7 9 Inch) - Round Nonstick Baking Pans Spring Form For Cheesecake, Tier Wedding Cakes, And More - Removable Bottom, Leakproof Bakeware Sets With Small, Medium, Large
features: MULTIPURPOSE: 4inch 4x2 Circular Bake Ware Set Is Great For Baby Birthday Cake, Layer Cake, Smash Cake, Pumpkin Pie, Kids Confection, Cinnamon Roll, Cheesecakes, Miniature Deep-Dish Pizza, Tart, Rounds, Fat Cookie

DURABLE: Each Tin Is Made With Double Layer Carbon Steel Rated Up to 450 Degrees Compatible With Oven Or 5/6 Qt Instant Pot Model (Compare to Weaker Aluminum Pans). Easy-Release Latch Provides Leak Proof Seal Between The Ring And Removable Metallic Tray (Won't Leak In Water Bath)

PRACTICAL: Silver Loaded Stainless Buckle Makes Sides Quickly Detachable When Done Cooking. Food-Grade Non-Stick Coating Makes It Easy To Remove Cake Or Food Without Need For Grease Or Flouring Before Use
WASHABLE: Easily Hand Wash With Light Soap For Best Maintenance, Or Place In Dishwasher For Quick Cleaning All At Once

VALUE: Bakeware Sets Come With 4 Personal Size Spring Foam Pans To Make Multiple Cakes At Once. Multiple Pieces Gives You The Versatility Of Using Multiple Forms And Making Cake Miniatures For Any Occasion. Always Have An Extra To Bake Something Else
